skillset.skill: 35s CT - For 15s, increase allies' Magic RES by 20%. If user is Fire, increase allies' Magic RES by 30% instead.

passive.ability1: If allies have 2 or more "-kyuon" equips equipped, increase allies' DMG resistance by 10%. Additionally if allies have 3 or more "-kyuon" equips equipped, increase allies' MAX HP by 10%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
